title: RenderingGen Multilingual Batch Manifest V1
description: Strategy-A batch master: one base video pass rendered once, then one overlay-only pass per language. The base job carries the shared background/source and entity geometry; each language job carries only the localized text/overlay plan and binds to the base artifact by its content hash. This halves-to-two-thirds GPU cost versus rendering each language from scratch: entities and background are rendered once and reused.

batch_id.description: Batch identifier scoping every derived job ID and idempotency key.

id.description: Logical base job ID within the batch.

render_plan.description: Semantic renderinggen.overlay-plan.v1 for the base pass (background/source video, shared entities; no language text).

language.description: BCP-47 tag (en, it, es...). Unique within the manifest.

base_job_id.description: Must equal the base entry's id when present (cross-checked at expansion).

render_plan.description: Language-specific semantic overlay-plan.v1 (localized strings and timings).

assets.description: Language-specific assets (localized ASS tracks, fonts, audio).

audio_source_asset.description: Localized voiceover audio muxed onto the base video during the overlay pass.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the asset bytes in the artifact store.

logical_path.description: Workspace-relative materialization path the render_plan references.
